---
name: Correction or erratum
about: Report a factual, technical, accessibility, citation, or editorial problem
title: "[Erratum]: "
labels: ["erratum", "needs-triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Location

Provide the file, heading, version, and line or paragraph where possible.

## Current text or behavior

Describe the issue without including sensitive information.

## Proposed correction

Provide replacement wording or the expected behavior.

## Evidence

Link authoritative sources, source versions, or reproducible validation.

## Impact

Explain whether the issue affects architecture decisions, security, safety, privacy, compliance interpretation, accessibility, or backward compatibility.

## Disclosure

List material affiliations or state “No material conflicts disclosed.”
